a: Django includes CSRF middleware and template tokens for forms.
Set a strong SECRET_KEY for sessions and signing in Flask.
Use bound parameters; never format raw SQL with user input.
Use secrets for tokens and cryptographic randomness, not random.
Prefer passlib/argon2/bcrypt over plain hashes for passwords.
Use Depends() to inject auth checks into routes cleanly.
Configure CORSMiddleware with explicit origins in production.
Validate size, content-type, and extension; store outside web root.
Block requests to internal IPs when fetching user-provided URLs.
Set HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, and CSP via middleware.
